user_saw: A structured question could fail to appear in a WhatsApp DM or leave a Mattermost conversation waiting for an answer to a question the user never saw.
summary: The fix exposes built-in ask_user only on surfaces with native question input or declared button support, so agents ask in ordinary text elsewhere.
reasoning: The original ask_user commit (#109922) registered the tool without a channel capability check and supplied a plain-text fallback. I checked the later WhatsApp reaction adapter (#110372), undelivered-prompt handling (#124148), and Mattermost button support (#135350), but the available evidence does not establish whether the reported failures existed at launch or began with a later change.
